Then reason: near-surface wind is jointly affected by the pressure gradient force, the geostrophic deflection force, and friction; the pressure gradient force points from high pressure to low pressure; in the Northern Hemisphere, the wind direction is deflected to the right relative to the pressure gradient force, and near-surface wind crosses the isobars obliquely and blows toward low pressure. method.method_draft: 先读图：这是北半球东亚附近的海平面等压线图，3地位于日本附近，周围等压线显示其一侧有较低气压中心，另一侧为较高气压。再判定气压梯度力由高压指向低压，并在北半球受地转偏向力向右偏、近地面又斜穿等压线指向低压。由3地附近等压线和低压方位合成风向，可判定空气从东南方向吹来，即东南风。
